provider: DriveWealth consolidated NBBO / Apex-QUODD B2B market-data infrastructure
evidence: DriveWealth officially documents a consolidated quote endpoint that fetches NBBO quote details for a security.
The DriveWealth endpoint is a back-office/partner API requiring partner bearer JWT and a dw-customer-user-id; it is not documented as a retail end-user self-service market-data API.

DriveWealth's integration documentation describes clients/partners as the entities building the customer-facing brokerage experience; in omnibus setups clients must source their own real-time market data.

Apex has an official strategic data partnership with QUODD to provide Apex clients access to real-time market-data feeds and Vendor-of-Record services, demonstrating the broker/fintech-absorbed licensing architecture.

Neither DriveWealth nor Apex/QUODD primary sources found here grant this project's retail end user permanent-$0 production automated/non-display National-NBBO API access. Production access is commercial/B2B integration territory; free sandbox/testing is not a permanent production entitlement.

gate_analysis.D: FAIL_FOR_CURRENT_USER; partner/back-office credentials required rather than retail self-service scheduler credential

reopen_condition: A DriveWealth/Apex-powered retail broker or fintech must officially expose a sanctioned end-user read-only API/connector with consolidated National-NBBO quote+trade event timestamps and explicitly grant permanent-$0 automated/non-display use with no balance/funding/activity/subscription/per-query/account-maintenance condition.
